E1309

`#Arg(flag_only: true)` on `name` has nothing to opt out of

What

`#Arg(flag_only: true)` on `name` has nothing to opt out of

Why

`flag_only: true` keeps a required value field off bare positional input. Bool fields, `T?` fields, and fields with a `{expr}` default are already flag-only.

Fix

Remove `flag_only: true`, or make the field a required scalar without a `{expr}` default.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1309: tests/ui/cli_flag_misuse.stderr.

Error [jet.RedundantFlagMarker]: `#Arg(flag_only: true)` on `verbose` has nothing to opt out of
  --> tests/ui/cli_flag_misuse.jet:3:21
    |
  3 |     #Arg(flag_only: true) verbose: Bool
    |                     ^^^^
 Why: `flag_only: true` keeps a required value field off bare positional input. Bool fields, optional fields (`T?`), and fields with a `{expr}` default already stay flag-only.
 Fix: Remove `flag_only: true`, or make the field a required scalar without a `{expr}` default
